Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

 Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

 Modelo de trabalho: Home office




Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.




O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.




O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.




O que você fará

Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.




Qualificações Mínimas

Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
Inglês fluente.




Qualificações Desejáveis

Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
Experiência em organização global matricial.

Our mission is to open the door to the life-changing impact of education and help make education accessible for all. As a nimble growth stage start-up, we've emerged as the leading online education platform helping over 30 million learners and educators each month. Study.com has earned numerous awards and it has been recognized as one of the most transformational companies in EdTech, living up to our commitment to all learners: Breakthroughs Start Here. From students and educators in over 9,000 school districts that use Study.com, to working adults striving to complete their college degree or gain professional certifications, we empower them to reach their full potential. Our product is our impact! Across our college programs alone we have saved students over $200M in tuition and enabled tens of thousands to become nurses, teachers, accountants and more. Additionally, as part of our mission we’ve donated over $27 million across social impact programs to learners and educators.




As a Financial Analyst at Study.com, you’ll play a key role in driving the company’s success by delivering actionable insights through financial and operational analysis and reporting. You’ll be part of a small, high-impact team, reporting to the Senior Manager of Finance while partnering closely with business leaders across the organization. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys working on multiple projects simultaneously, and feels confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels of leadership.




What You’ll Do:

Support the budget-planning cycle for revenue and expenses, including annual plans, re-forecasts, monthly close, variance analysis, and monthly executive and board reports
Collaborate with Accounting to ensure timely and accurate financial close entries
Operate as an AI-first financial analyst. User of AI tools and plugins to drive efficiency and results in your role, including ChatGPT, Claude, Shortcut AI, Prophix One FP&A Plus, AI Agents and others
Create intuitive analytic tools, reports, spreadsheets, and models that synthesize multiple data sources into actionable business insights
Partner with department leaders to analyze drivers, trends, and opportunities providing data-driven insights and strategic recommendations
Conduct ad hoc analysis of global operations and present findings to senior management to support strategic decision-making
Manage Prophix (CPM tool), including system maintenance and updates
Proactively identify and implement innovative process improvements to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness of planning and analysis activities




What You’ll Bring to this Role: 

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field
5-7 years of professional experience in corporate finance roles
Collaborative mindset with strong verbal and written skills
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel
AI-first experience – you use AI first to solve problems before trying it any other way
Familiarity with CPM tools preferred (e.g., Prophix, Adaptive Insights)
Python or other coding experience, including Cursor or Claude Code a plus
B2C SaaS industry experience required

Since launching 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100M with backing from Lightspeed, Khosla, and Google Ventures. We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring the best and brightest talent. To accelerate that momentum, we’re growing our team.




Come and join us at one of NYC’s fastest-growing startups and have an impact on our product from day one.




As our CX & Implementations Lead, you’ll own ERP implementations end-to-end and build best-in-class customer relationships. This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership.




You’ll be joining at an early and defining moment. Move at rocket speed, build the next massive ERP behemoth.




About DualEntry

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of NYC’s fastest-growing AI startups.




DualEntry is changing the future of finance. Our AI-native ERP lets teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away busywork and fuel their growth with powerful reporting and insights. We’re making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990s in the past.




We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.




Where you'll create impact

You’ll own end-to-end ERP implementations and long-term customer relationships
You’ll deliver best-in-class onboarding, go-live execution, and ongoing CX excellence
You’ll collaborate with founders, product, and engineering to shape the roadmap based on real customer feedback
You’ll establish and evolve implementation methodologies, processes, and operational standards
You’ll challenge the status quo of what world-class ERP customer success looks like
You’ll drive outcomes that meaningfully accelerate customer adoption and satisfaction




What sets you up for success

3–6+ years of experience in ERP implementations, ERP functional consulting, or accounting/advisory
Strong preference for an accounting or audit background (CPA or Big 4 is a major plus)
Deep understanding of ERP systems, finance workflows, and implementation best practices
You’re a customer-service expert who loves solving complex problems
You thrive in fast-moving, early stage environments with high ownership
Expertise in Accounting, audit, ERP systems, (CPA is a bonus)




Why you’ll thrive here

Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world
You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry
Your feedback shapes the product directly
High-speed cultureHigh-trust environment with high expectations
Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years




Benefits & Compensation

Early-stage role with high autonomy and real long-term upside
Equity: $60,000+
Base Salary: $75,000 – $150,000 USD
Contract type: B2B
Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with
Visa sponsorship provided plus relocation assistance to New York after 2 years 
Time Off: 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays
Enjoy a learning & development budget for courses, certifications, and language learning to keep growing your skills
Work where you feel most productive at co-working spaces or from your home office with support for setup, internet, and phone
Plus, wellness perks and more to make your workday even better!




We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a restructure like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do.




If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

About SMC

SMC is a strategy-led agency focused on social media and performance, partnering with global brands and market leaders. We’re growing and looking for someone who turns data into strategic clarity and actionable intelligence.




The role

This BI Analyst role exists to transform fragmented data into clear, reliable, decision-ready intelligence.

It’s not just about reporting what happened — it’s about explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

You’ll bridge data and strategy, supporting leadership with structured analysis, context, and practical recommendations. 




Responsibilities




1) Data Intelligence & Performance Analysis

Structure, analyze, and interpret business, product, and operational data
Monitor growth, efficiency, and performance KPIs
Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and performance shifts
Run historical and comparative analyses
Focus: insight, context, and impact — not just numbers.




2) Reporting & Strategic Insights

Build monthly BI/performance reports
Create analyses for launches, initiatives, and tests
Deliver executive insights to support decision-making
Avoid data overload — prioritize clarity and direction




3) Data Structure & Consistency

Organize and maintain internal datasets
Standardize KPI definitions and analytical logic
Validate data before analysis and presentations
Create lightweight documentation for key metrics
Goal: reduce ambiguity, rework, and operational noise.




4) Decision Support & Strategic Partnership

Support prioritization, planning, and strategic decisions
Identify risks, opportunities, and performance gaps
Build projections and scenarios when needed
This role connects data to strategy — not operational execution.




Key deliverables


Recurring

Monthly BI/performance report
Executive and/or operational dashboards
Analytical inputs for leadership meetings

On-demand

Deep dives on performance drivers
Project-specific analyses
Comparative or exploratory studies




Out of scope
Campaign or project execution
Content creation
Heavy data engineering/infrastructure build
Extensive tool training




Qualifications


Must-have

Strong analytical thinking, autonomy, and business mindset (not a junior role)
Ability to translate data into decisions and clear next steps
Clear, structured communication (written and verbal)
Strong Google Sheets (and Excel) skills; comfortable working with early-stage/messy datasets
Hands-on experience building dashboards and executive-ready reporting (e.g., Looker Studio or equivalent)
Ability to define/standardize KPIs and run basic data validation




Nice to have

Working knowledge of SQL
Familiarity with GA4 and performance metrics (social/paid/web)
Experience setting up BI/reporting foundations from scratch (standards, glossary, routines)




Languages & availability

Portuguese and English are used day-to-day. 

This role supports a globally distributed operation. We’re looking for someone who can work primarily in BRT and maintain consistent overlap with Americas/Europe working hours when needed. 




How to apply

FP&A Analyst (Functional & Technical – Commercial Sector Focus)







Overview

We are seeking a highly capable FP&A Analyst who brings both functional depth and technical agility to the table. This role will support high-impact client engagements, particularly in the commercial sector space, while contributing to our broader digital transformation consulting initiatives.




You will collaborate with senior consultants and clients to optimize FP&A workflows, support financial systems implementation (e.g., Anaplan, Pigment), and drive strategic alignment across finance functions. Ideal candidates will be fluent in the language of finance and analytics, with hands-on experience in both process design and technical systems support.




Key Responsibilities

FP&A Process Design & Optimization

Assess and redesign clients’ budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes to improve clarity, efficiency, and scalability.
Lead or support workflow reengineering initiatives to optimize planning cycles and reporting cadence.
Align finance processes across business units, ensuring consistency and actionable insights.




Technology Implementation Support

Act as a functional subject matter expert (SME) for FP&A solution implementations (e.g., Anaplan, Pigment, Adaptive Insights).
Translate business requirements into technical specifications/user stories.
Partner with IT and solution architects to support system configuration, data migration, and integration.




Stakeholder Collaboration & Enablement

Engage directly with client finance teams, IT stakeholders, and senior leadership.
Conduct trainings and knowledge transfer sessions for new tools and processes.
Build trusted relationships that foster adoption and long-term value.




Agile Delivery & Cross-Functional Work

Participate in Agile project teams, including ceremonies like standups, retrospectives, and sprint planning.
Collaborate with consultants, developers, and project managers to ensure on-time, iterative delivery.
Identify and communicate project risks, blockers, and areas for improvement.




Reporting & Data Strategy

Support accurate, timely data collection and validation for all planning and forecasting cycles.
Contribute to ad hoc reporting, scenario modeling, and board-level presentations. 
Provide insights for decision-making through a combination of financial analysis and system data visibility.




Future Pipeline & Growth Contribution

Remain agile to support clients in both the public/nonprofit and commercial sectors.
Contribute to future project phases, including data architecture, advanced analytics, and FP&A operating model design.




Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field.
3–7+ years of progressive FP&A experience, with a strong emphasis on process improvement and stakeholder engagement.
Prior experience in NGO or public sector FP&A settings (preferred), or strong commercial FP&A exposure.
Hands-on experience with budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting cycles.
Familiarity with modern FP&A systems such as Anaplan, Pigment, TM1, Adaptive Insights, or similar.
Ability to translate functional needs into clear system requirements.
Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; data manipulation and scenario analysis proficiency.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage cross-functional teams.
Consulting or client-facing experience a strong plus.




Desired (Bonus) Qualifications

Certifications in finance (e.g., CFA, CPA, CIMA) or FP&A systems (e.g., Anaplan Model Builder).
Knowledge of ERP systems and finance data integrations.
Experience in Agile/Scrum project delivery environments.
Background in solution architecture, data architecture, or transformation programs.
Experience mentoring junior analysts or end-user training.




Working Arrangements

Must be self-motivated, reliable, and capable of working independently with minimal oversight.
Willingness to align with global project timelines and participate in virtual meetings as needed.




What We Offer

Work on strategic consulting projects across nonprofit, public, and commercial sectors.
Exposure to modern FP&A tools and digital transformation initiatives.
Career path toward specialized functional, technical, or leadership roles.
Collaborative, values-driven culture focused on quality, impact, and continuous learning.

Flag process gaps and suggest improvements to increase efficiency.
